hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, bordering the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea, north of Yemen || mostly sandy desert || Saudi Arabia is the largest country in the world without a river; extensive coastlines on the Persian Gulf and Red Sea allow for considerable shipping (especially of crude oil) through the Persian Gulf and Suez Canal || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, iron ore, gold, copper || Exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, plastics, alcohols, ships (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly sandy desert || Middle East, bordering the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea, north of Yemen

climate.excerpt: harsh, dry desert with great temperature extremes || frequent sand and dust storms volcanism: little activity in the past few centuries, despite many volcanic formations; volcanoes include Harrat Rahat, Harrat Khaybar, Harrat Lunayyir, and Jabal Yar

economy.excerpt: high-income, oil-based Middle Eastern economy; OPEC founding member; Vision 2030 strategy prioritizing economic diversification, increased private sector involvement, and projects funded by sovereign wealth fund and foreign investment; young labor force; falling but significant poverty rate despite lack of official statistics || Exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, plastics, alcohols, ships (2023) || Industries: crude oil production, petroleum refining, basic petrochemicals, ammonia, industrial gases, sodium hydroxide (caustic soda), cement, fertilizer, plastics, metals, commercial ship repair, commercial aircraft repair, construction

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Muslim (official; citizens are 85-90% Sunni and 10-12% Shia), other (includes Eastern Orthodox, Protestant, Roman Catholic, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, and Sikh) (2020 est.) || Arab 90%, Afro-Asian 10%
